blocks.text: Barber Street Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Barber Street is a board sub-area name inside the City of Port Moody's Pleasantside neighbourhood, not a City neighbourhood name: the City's Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw, 2026, No.
The name comes from one street: Barber Street runs off Ioco Road on the north shore of the Port Moody Arm, and Pleasantside Elementary School sits on it at 195 Barber Street.

The working street set is the shore strip below Ioco Road — Barber Street, Alderside Road and the lanes off them — with Ioco Road as the only through road and Old Orchard Park at the west end of the shoreline.

blocks.text: Barber Street Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses on the shore strip below Ioco Road, on Barber Street, Alderside Road and the lanes off them, in the Pleasantside section of the Port Moody 2050 Official Community Plan.

blocks.text: Barber Street Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The RS1-S small-lot rezoning route is available in Pleasantside — one of the few Port Moody areas where it is offered — with minimum lot figures of 9 metres width and 325 square metres.
Small-scale multi-unit housing is permitted in the RS and RT zones outside the City's transit-oriented areas, under the provincial housing legislation the City has implemented.
Port Moody is inside the speculation and vacancy tax taxable area, so residential owners here must declare each year.

blocks.text: Barber Street Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The sub-area is named for a single short street, so a "Barber Street" listing is on or just off Barber Street and Alderside Road, not in a large district.
Ioco Road is the only through road: every shore street hangs off it, so road work on Ioco Road affects the whole strip.

blocks.text: Barber Street Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Port Moody property taxes are set city-wide under the Port Moody 2050 planning framework, and the speculation and vacancy tax applies in Port Moody, so owners declare annually.
Ioco Road is the only through road along the north shore of the Port Moody Arm, and the shore streets — Barber Street and Alderside Road — hang off it.
The Shoreline Trail system begins at Rocky Point Park to the east, tying the shore to the Moody Centre side of the city.

blocks.text: Barber Street Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Confirm the SD43 catchment for the exact address, since the elementary school on the street does not settle the middle and secondary assignments.
Check shoreline and slope conditions with the City for a waterfront-side lot, since the shore strip sits below Ioco Road on the Port Moody Arm.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Barber Street?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in Barber Street. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Barber Street a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Barber Street had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Barber Street from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Barber Street over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Barber Street?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which elementary school serves Barber Street?
faq.a: Pleasantside Elementary School stands on the street itself, at 195 Barber Street, per the school's own School District No.

faq.q: What is at the end of the shoreline?
faq.a: Old Orchard Park, at the west end of the shoreline below Ioco Road, is the shore's park anchor, and the City is running master plans for Rocky Point and Old Orchard parks together.

faq.q: What did houses in Barber Street sell for?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Barber Street between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,848,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Barber Street?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.3% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
